s0.p1: Let’s discuss the call context of ordinary and arrow functions
s0.p2: The default call context of an ordinary function is set at the time of its declaration, but can be changed at the time of the call using the methods ⟦f0⟧ or ⟦f1⟧
s0.p3: However, to declare an ordinary function, we can use ⟦f2⟧ or ⟦f3⟧
